candidates.title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
candidates.reason: Strong fit for disaggregated serving and KV-transfer bottlenecks; primary source reports selective KV transfer with up to 4.3x lower time-to-second-token versus full transfer.

candidates.title: SuperInfer: SLO-Aware Rotary Scheduling and Memory Management for LLM Inference on Superchips
candidates.reason: Strong fit for hierarchical memory and SLO-aware serving; evaluates tightly coupled CPU-GPU memory on GH200 and reports substantial TTFT SLO-attainment gains.

candidates.title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
candidates.reason: High-value systems paper spanning KV offload, cross-engine cache transfer, CPU/storage/network hierarchy, vLLM/SGLang integration, and an open-source implementation.

candidates.title: Robust KV Cache Management for LLM Serving under Output Token Length Uncertainty
candidates.reason: Relevant to KV-memory allocation, routing, prefix caching, SLOs, and uncertain output length; trace-driven evaluation reports up to 56% lower cost than fixed-quantile reservation baselines.

candidates.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Strong KV-cache memory-management candidate with public code and explicit long-context memory/quality tradeoff evaluation.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Recent and high-value primary-source search covering KV cache transfer, hierarchical memory, SLO-aware serving, uncertain KV reservation, and KV compression.
